beat_1_a: If every human on Earth suddenly lost the ability to speak...
beat_1_b: the silence wouldn't be the scariest part.
beat_2_a: Inside your throat, two tiny folds of muscle
beat_2_b: that normally vibrate hundreds of times a second would simply... stop.
beat_3_a: Within minutes, emergency calls go dead quiet,
beat_3_b: and air traffic control can't talk down a single plane.
beat_4_a: But your brain wouldn't give up.
beat_4_b: The same region that builds spoken sentences also powers sign language.
beat_5_b: In the 1980s, deaf children in Nicaragua invented a brand-new sign language almost from scratch.
beat_6_a: So humanity wouldn't stay silent for long... we'd just start talking with our hands.
